notes:
Snapshot: mid-market billing SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted API with view to move to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Strong emphasis on streaming + tool-calls to Stripe/Zuora and returning strict JSON for downstream systems.

Top priorities / constraints:
- Latency SLO: conversational streaming tail target: 300-500ms for token streaming in common flows (quote from CTO: "sub-500ms is must-have for agent UX").
- Throughput: support 150-250 concurrent agent sessions initially; peak concurrency for end-of-month billing spikes ~400 sessions.
- Tooling: must call Stripe (charge/issue-refund) and Zuora (subscription amendments) from models; structured output required (JSON schema) for automated playbooks.
- Security: SOC2 mandatory, SSO (SAML) for agents, audit logs for all tool calls, KMS for envelope keys. Data residency preference: US only for payment data.
- Cost: unit-cost sensitivity; team wants Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization tradeoffs.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-02-24: Intro demo w/ AE (Marisa) + SE (Daniel). Walked through hosted streaming and function-calling patterns. Fireflies: ff-2026-03-02-793ab.
- 2026-03-02: Deep-dive call with engineering: provided sample Stripe/Zuora tool adapters, asked about guaranteed ordering of tool calls and idempotency.
- 2026-03-05: Sent SOC2 questionnaire + SSO integration checklist (drive link). Security team requested KMS integration guide. Linked ticket SEC-87 opened.
- 2026-03-09: Demo feedback: "streaming latency felt good on synthetic tests, still seeing spikes under burst; want 99th percentile metrics for streaming path". Added INFRA-4123 to investigate autoscale behavior.
- 2026-03-11: Pricing conversation with finance — they want dedicated reserved baseline for 3 GPUs with 2:1 burst credit; need firm pricing for 12-month commit vs consumption.

POC plan (proposed): 2-week hosted API POC to validate: real tool-calling to staging Stripe, structured JSON outputs for 5 canonical workflows (refund, plan-change, invoice-summary, retry-payment, prorate-calc), streaming UX under synthetic load. Acceptance criteria: streaming 95th p95 < 350ms, structured JSON schema pass rate > 98%, tool-call idempotency verified.

Notes from customer reps (shorthand):
- "If hosted demo hits targets we'll want dedicated pricing next week" — head of product.
- SE asks: need sample rollout policy for fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained.
- Legal: retention windows + deletion proof required before procurement.

Open action items:
- Redwood: provide explicit dedicated pricing sheet (baseline + burst) and 12-month commit scenarios (Marisa).
- Security: provide KMS integration docs + sample SAML metadata (Daniel).
- FlowBridge: deliver 5 canonical prompt sets + json schema for structured outputs.
- Schedule: POC kickoff tentatively 2026-03-20, engineering sync 2026-03-18.

Stakes: mid-market ARR potential, relatively low integration complexity but high UX/latency bar; win likely to convert to Dedicated if pricing for burst/commit aligns.
